symbol.description: The name asked for, on a `--symbol` query.

empty.description: Nothing outside the diff depends on the change, and no search left a gap.

messages.description:
The newest of those commits' messages, subject and body: locate and pack
carry them, impact does not.

Spelled.description: A name no file defines, spelled in files.

gap.description: What this build read as text and could not tell a definition in.

line.description: The first line that spells the name.

Gap.description:
Why a search of a definition's uses is not complete: the closed vocabulary that
replaces v1's sentence in `unresolved`.

oneOf.description:
Uses of the name that nothing resolves or rules out: an untyped receiver, a
name no import binds.

sites.description: The first of them; the rest are counted in `uses`.

oneOf.description: The two sides of the range pair the definition in more than one way.
The run stopped before the search finished.

`files` of the definition's interaction group the run could neither read as
source nor rule out by the names they spell: why, in `reason`.

name.description: The block-scoped binding no tracked definition stands for, when one does.

oneOf.description:
A member of a trait, or the implementation of one: calls arrive through
`dyn Trait` and generic bounds.

`files` that could name it declare items through a macro (`what`) that is
not expanded.
A name defined in many files of a language without a binding model.
Code in a language no binding model reads.

No direct caller was found, and a supertype, an interface or the runtime can
call it through `via`, which nothing traces.
`files` hold a template that was read around, not expanded.
`files` of a chart or release whose values or context are not determined.
`files` generate objects whose names are not written in any file.
`pointers` name a source outside the repository, which was not followed.
`files` run or read a path the shell computes at run time.

Untracked directories the read of the checkout did not enter: `total` of
them, `directories` the first named. A use of the name in them is unknown.

Site.description: A candidate use: where it is, and what it may be.

Via.description: How the answer words a candidate use.

LimitReason.description:
Why a run did not do everything it could have. One vocabulary for every
phase; consumers read `coverage.limits` and never a per-subsystem
boolean.

oneOf.description:
A file cut to `max_fragments_per_file`: what the diff touched survives
the cut, the rest is the longest fragments only.

A changed or context file that was not UTF-8 and was decoded lossily;
`coverage.lossy_files` names them.

The caller withdrew the request (an MCP cancellation, the MCP
deadline): work stopped at the next poll instead of running on
detached.

A git read the answer depends on failed (`git grep`, a file
listing): what it would have found is unknown, never none.

Reason.description: Why a file of a definition's interaction group is not accounted for.

oneOf.description:
The file is of the group, spells a name, and no cell binds names to this
definition's language.
The definition is in no group, or its group holds no file.

withheld.description: Files the run withheld (ignore rules, secret names): not read.

Listing.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

lines.description: Head-side lines; base-side when the change is a removal.

kind.description: The definition's kind; absent when v1 said only that it was removed.

entry.description: The role that gives it an implicit caller: a runner, a registry, `main`.

guard.description: Whether a test reaches the definition itself; stated only when none does.

also_changed.description: Users the range changes too, resolved: the diff's own lines.

possibly_also_changed.description: Users the range changes too whose binding is not resolved.

missed_in.description:
Files in view that spell the name but were not analysed whole: a use there is
not seen, so an empty `rows` says nothing about them.

gaps.description: Why the search is incomplete, in words of the closed vocabulary.

origin.description: `moved` or `renamed`, when the pairing says so.

Delta.description:
What differs between the two sides of an edited definition: the folding
table's own reading.

LocalOf.description:
A definition that is a local of another, not one of its own: its uses are the
ones inside the enclosing one.

test.description: The first test file (`linked`) in path order, or the unread one (`unread`).

name.description: The function of that test, where the answer resolved it.

via.description: The function between the caller and the test.

also.description:
The other tests that reach the caller at the same fewest hops: the first
of each test file, then the rest, in path then name order, three tests in all.

more.description: How many more reach it beyond those named.

registrar.description: The decorator (`registered`), or the framework's own sentence (`entry_point`).

GuardState.description:
Whether a test reaches a caller: v1's `tested_by`, `tested_via`, `file_tested`,
`registered_by` and `unread_test`, as one state and what names it.

oneOf.description: A test reaches it by a static link.
A test reaches its file but none of the paths to it.
Tests were in view and none reaches it.
A decorator registers it: whatever reads the registry reaches it.
A framework enters it (a route, a command, a job): `registrar` states how.
A test file the size cap kept out names it.
No test file was in view.

The search for a test is open above the definition: a test past the naming
bound, a use whose account holds a hedge, or a stopped run. A test may be
there, so no absence is claimed.

GuardTest.description: A test that reaches a caller, beyond the first the guard names.

name.description: The test function, where the answer resolved it.

via.description: The function between the caller and the test.

Row.description: A use of a changed definition (v1's `Caller`).

kind.description:
What the row does (`calls`, `reads`, ...), stated only where the (language,
relation) cell is precise; absent elsewhere.

folded_by.description: The rule of the folding table that would fold the row; only under `unfold`.

Class.description: How a row uses the definition, coarsely and always.

Standing.description: How sure the resolver is of a row.

oneOf.description: A word match: listed as text, never counted as a caller.

Fold.description:
Rows of one definition the folding table says the change cannot have affected,
counted in one line.

examples.description: Tests first, then by path and line.

Count.description:
A number of uses, and whether it is the whole: `exact` only under the witness
of a complete search, otherwise `n` is the least there are.

DefRef.description: A definition, named where a v1 string said `path::symbol (lines)`.

Searched.description:
Calls (calls, constructions, overrides) and reads (reads, writes, a value passed
on) are searched, and can be known, apart.

Search.description:
What the search of one group of relations covered. `complete` is the witness: no
row of the group in the answer then means no such use exists in the analysed
scope, and a count over it is exact.

reason.description:
`no_grammar`, `parse_timeout`, `parse_failed` (nothing read),
`parse_partial` (read but for the error lines), `too_large` (over the
size cap), `unreadable`, `content_untraced`: a file outside code
whose keys, values or rules something may read, of which only the
lines naming the file by path were searched, or `outside_definitions`:
code the range changed that no tracked definition holds (a module-level
statement, a `__main__` block), whose effect is not traced.

lines.description:
Where the parse broke, the first few lines; for `outside_definitions`,
the first and last line of each changed run, in pairs.

ShedRows.description:
Rows the answer cap shed, by what they were: the ledger every total of shed rows
is a sum of, filled where the rows are shed.

untested.description: Of those, the rows no static test link reaches.

Omitted.description:
What the answer cap shed whole: the one count of definitions, the names that
fit, and the budget that shows them.

shed.description:
The rows of every shed definition, named or not: the names are capped, this is
not.

incomplete.description:
Of the shed definitions, named or not, those whose search for calls was not
complete: the counts that include their rows are the least there are.

Listing2.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

OmittedDefinition.description: A definition the cap shed, and what it had.

incomplete.description: Its search for calls was not complete when it was shed.

Unlisted.description: Changed definitions the answer does not list as entries, each for a reason.

no_caller.description: Complete searches found no caller: the absence claim.

Listing3.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

Unreached.description:
A definition listed apart from the entries, with the role that gives it an
implicit caller when it has one (a runner, a registry): the role is why a missing
test link is a finding there.

Listing4.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

Listing5.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

Listing6.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

Listing7.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

StaleRef.description: A line that still names a path the change deleted or renamed.

class.description:
The kind of place the line sits in: a script names the path as a command, a
document only talks about it.

Class2.description: The kind of place a path is mentioned in.

oneOf.description: A string or an identifier of a source file.
A value of a structured config.
A line that starts a program.
A document, a patch, a comment, a sentence.
Rows of data, a log, a file no tool reads.
An ignore or attribute file: it selects paths and reads none.

Named.description:
Lines outside the diff that name a changed file by its path, or by a key it
changed.

Listing8.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

target.description: The changed file the line names.

key.description:
A key the change touched in `target`, which the line spells: a
textual match, not a resolved binding (#686).

KeySearch.description: A changed file outside code whose changed keys were searched as text.

named.description: The lines outside the diff naming any of them.

Listing9.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

collection.description:
The collection the call names; absent when the name is computed at
run time, so the call may read any collection.

Listing10.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

DeletedModule.description:
A module the range deletes and no file at the head imports: its definitions
are named once, here, since nothing can reach any of them.

dynamic_import.description:
An import whose name is computed at run time could reach it, and the facts
cannot rule one out: "no importers" is what was found, not a proof.

known.description: Whether any test file was in view: without one, an absent link says nothing.

hops.description: How many call hops a static test link reaches.

RunCoverage.description: What the run did not cover as a whole.

untraced_omitted.description:
Of the unanalysed files left out of the listing, those outside code that only
their path was searched for.

not_searched.description: Definitions the run stopped before it searched and the cap then dropped.

keys_unsearched.description: Changed configs whose keys and values the capped text search left out.

Listing11.description:
A list and its total, which travel together: the items shown are the first of
`total`.

Summary.description: The totals the Markdown header prints, from the same leaves.

traced.description:
Changed definitions whose callers were traced; none with comments or
formatting only is "callers not traced", not "no callers".

Fit.description: The cap the answer was fitted to.

asked.description: The budget asked for; absent when the run sized the answer itself.

needs.description:
What showing everything would take, to the next hundred tokens; absent
until a fit measured it.

least.description: Set when the least the answer can say still outgrows the cap.

exempt.description: Tokens the cap does not charge: a raw diff, which is input verbatim.
